status: candidate record. Owner approval for this revision is NOT recorded. The full release matrix has not been run against it. Do not treat it as an approval.
scopeRequested: One instruction, raised from a screenshot of /ai-gtm: on every page, the left edge of the top bar's wordmark must be the left edge of that page's content. R17 introduced --mm-header-inline so the mark could take each route's own edge and measured it against the two locked routes' headings; nothing had measured the rest of the body. Five drifts were found and fixed, and the gate that would have caught them was written. No page-body redesign, no new commercial offer, no approved copy replaced, and no change to the immutable R3 prototype or its generated adapter.
sessionDecisions: Move the shared commercial block onto --mm-header-inline rather than duplicating route edges into its own stylesheet. R18 on main has since restricted that block to /new-age-leadership, which is the one route where this now has any effect, and it is the route where it is needed: the R5 surface's edge, not the container's.

Fix .mm-container's auto margin rather than the three blocks that tripped over it. The auto margin and the written-out start margin resolve to the same edge for a container at its own width and differ only when something narrows the box, which is the bug.
Mirror the R5 surface's --edge into a new .mm-route-leadership class in src/styles/mindmake.css rather than editing the generated src/styles/new-age-leadership-r5.css.

Correct the R3 chapter insets in the hand-written integration.css, not the generated component-styles.css, and move all five of them rather than only the 4.5% one. The phone was the larger half: copy at 6%, rails at 5%, panels at 7% and the mode switch at a flat 12px against a mark at 20px. Insets only, so nothing changes width, height, vertical position, type or colour, and deleting the block restores the drawn numbers exactly.
Leave the configurator's unrendered chapter variants at their own numbers. A rule for a frame nothing selects is a rule nobody can check.
Give the 404 the real shell rather than nudging its centred card. It was the one page with no top bar, no menu and no footer, and a lost visitor could leave it only by the two links on it.
Write the gate before claiming the fix. Every one of these had passed every existing gate, because exit 0 proves a page rendered, not that it lines up.
changePolicy: This is a new immutable record. Never rewrite r1, r2, or any candidate or earlier approval manifest. Material routes remain locked. The CI workflow may enforce stricter non-material verification only through a new manifest revision. Owner approval, production deployment and publication remain separate authority gates, none of which this record supplies.
